text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the 1st Live, I feel like 
something has been changing inside <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's as if the fiery passion she received 
at the venue that day still dwells within 
her body..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I brought this matter up with Light 
Hello during our meeting—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Wait. S-Sorry for suddenly blurting 
this out...! To tell the truth, ever since 
the day of the 1st Live, I feel like my 
work efficiency has gone up too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps this too is the power of a 
live performance."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, whether performing or just 
spectating, a good live concert experience 
influences morale and growth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Which songs should be included in the 
next live setlist? Knowing it was for <chrname>'s 
sake only invigorated them even further—"
